summary: This stable release improves cleanup for local Codex requests and adds source-checkout tooling for controlled Harness trials.
highlights: Update the bundled SQLite dependency to a release that fixes CVE-2026-119375.
When a local Codex request times out or is cancelled on macOS or Linux, Wombat can stop remaining processes in the owned group after the main process exits.

From a source checkout on macOS arm64, use the real-task Harness trial to compare the baseline, two instruction candidates, and a composed version on one selected text task. The report includes deliverables, independent checks, and the rationale for the proposed changes.
knownLimitations: Harness trials require a source checkout and an existing Codex login. The installed CLI and plugin ship the existing analysis and cleanup workflows.
Trial reports support manual review. Applying or undoing candidate instructions and starting trials from the installed conversation entry remain planned.
